title: Unit 408 living: three Opus directions (D, E, F)
overview: Three Opus directions for the Unit 408 living area, each a complete room with its own seating option so Ivan chooses a design rather than a plan: D Midnight and Cherry (navy velvet, cherry red, white gloss and chrome), E Apricot and Charcoal (a round-armed bouclé curve, charcoal concrete and black steel), F Narra and Solihiya (a Filipino heritage sala in dark wood and cane). All three keep the window AC front clear, the honey-amber parquet, the dark timber hallway arch, the Davies Beige blackout curtains with voile on valance boards and shelves in the TV-wall recess. Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured.
requirements: All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, lighting, rugs, textiles and decor; no model or family repeats across the schemes or the parallel sets.
Every piece fits the measured room with clear walkways and door swings; plans use published dimensions and flag the rest.
Seating, tables and storage are real catalogue products with a supplier photo, price and source link.
procurement_gates: Prices are catalogue references with each line's own price date. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.
Pieces flagged "dims unpublished" in the room placement report keep the layout size; measure them at the showroom before ordering.
Delivery path for the sofa, dining table and buffet (lift, corridor, door widths) to be confirmed with the building before ordering.
Style renders are AI interpretations painted over the dimension-led model views; supplier photo boards, measured plans and the item schedule are the acceptance basis.

schemes.title: Midnight and Cherry
schemes.rationale: a navy velvet channel-tufted 3-seater and one cherry-red wing chair against white high gloss, chrome and black, a charcoal-and-white striped flatweave underfoot and white glass-door bookcases filling the TV-wall recess
fit_notes: Seating option D: 3-seater along the south window facing the TV, the wing chair along the east window south of the window AC, an oval coffee table between, a side table at the east end of the sofa, the striped rug 2400 x 1700 under the table and the front sofa legs.
TV-wall recess (307 x 1161): two white glass-door bookcases (2 x 400 wide, 300 deep, 2020 high) stand in it facing the room.
Curtain lines kept: 250 mm behind the sofa and the chair; the floor in front of the window AC stays clear; the hallway arch and the bay keep their walkways.

Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured; sills, heads, door heights, the fan and AC positions, the TV-wall recess and the hallway arch (1450 x 2240) are assumed (see ASSUMED.md), the 2.7 m ceiling is as Ivan stated it, and every plan and view depends on them until taped.

schemes.title: Apricot and Charcoal
schemes.rationale: one sculptural round-armed bouclé sofa in warm apricot-tan with a cream swivel chair and a charcoal concrete pedestal table, a black fluted TV stand and black steel shelves, a rice-paper column lamp and one faux travertine drink table
fit_notes: Seating option E: round-armed 3-seater along the south window facing the TV, the swivel chair on the east side south of the window AC turned toward the TV, the 1117 round table between, the drink table at the east end of the sofa, an off-white rug 2400 x 1700.
TV-wall recess (307 x 1161): three black bracket wall shelves (1010 wide, 200 deep) one above the other.
Curtain lines kept: 250 mm behind the sofa and the chair; the floor in front of the window AC stays clear; the hallway arch and the bay keep their walkways.

Conditional fit: the living is not site-measured; sills, heads, door heights, the fan and AC positions, the TV-wall recess and the hallway arch (1450 x 2240) are assumed (see ASSUMED.md), the 2.7 m ceiling is as Ivan stated it, and every plan and view depends on them until taped.

schemes.title: Narra and Solihiya
schemes.rationale: a Filipino heritage sala in dark-stained solid wood and solihiya cane: a scroll-armed 2-seater and two matching lounge chairs with cream cushions, a round cane-arched coffee table, a dark walnut TV cabinet, a bamboo column lamp and a woven black-and-cream wall piece
fit_notes: Seating option F: 2-seater along the south window facing the TV, the two lounge chairs side by side along the east window, both south of the window AC, the round coffee table between, a cream rug 2400 x 1700.
TV-wall recess (307 x 1161): an open rubberwood rack (900 wide, 300 deep, 1800 high).
Mejore publishes no dimensions for the 2-seater and the lounge chairs: the plan uses planning sizes (1550 x 850 and 900 x 850) until they are checked in the showroom.
